description: Authorizes Terramind to send an organization's marketing email from its own domain through Resend: a DKIM signing key, the return-path MX and SPF on send.<domain>, and a DMARC policy when the domain has none.
variableDescription: %dkimSelector%: the DKIM selector Resend issued for this domain (usually resend); %dkimKey%: the DKIM public key, without the p= prefix; %region%: the Amazon SES region of the return-path MX, e.g. us-east-1. Apply with domain=<zone> and host=<sub-domain> when sending from a sub-domain.
